infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RESQ-Link Responder uses the camera to capture post-incident scene photos you choose to attach to reports.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RESQ-Link Responder uses your photo library so you can attach scene photos to incident reports.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RESQ-Link Responder uses your location to share live GPS with dispatch when enabled and to navigate to incident locations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RESQ-Link Responder uses your location to share live GPS with dispatch when enabled and to navigate to incident locations.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: RESQ-Link Responder does not access your contacts. This description is required because a bundled system library may reference the Contacts API; the app never reads or stores contact information.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to share your live location with dispatch and navigate to emergency incidents.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to share your live location with dispatch and navigate to emergency incidents.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to share your live location with dispatch and navigate to emergency incidents.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access photos so you can attach scene images to incident reports.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera to capture post-incident scene photos.
